start: Member page of a member whose gym plan ends on the 30th; the member was ill for a week; owner signed in, online

steps.action: On the plan that ends last tap "Freeze / extra days"
user_sees: Sheet titled "Freeze / extra days"
"<Plan name> last day: <30th>."
"Reason" with "Freeze – Medical" picked, "Freeze – Travel", "Freeze – Other", "Gift – Extra days"
"How many days" with "7 days" picked, "15 days", "30 days"
Box "Or type the days (1–365)" holding 7
"New last day: <7 days later>" and "Valid till then (<how far from today>)."
Button "Add 7 days"
must_not: A new last day that is not exactly 7 days after the old one

steps.action: Tap "15 days"
user_sees: The box shows 15; "New last day" moves; the button reads "Add 15 days"
must_not: The button still saying 7

steps.action: Tap "Add 15 days"
user_sees: "Saving…"
The sheet closes
"Plan moved 15 days later."
must_not: The days added twice
A receipt or a charge made for free days

steps.action: Look at the plan and its history
user_sees: The new last day
History line "+15 days (Freeze - medical): <old> → <new>"
must_not: The start date moved
The price or dues changed

start: Member page of a member whose only plan ended 10 days ago

steps.action: Tap "Freeze / extra days" on the ended plan
user_sees: "<Plan name> ended on <date>."
must_not: The button missing on an ended plan

steps.action: Keep 7 days
user_sees: "New last day: <date>" and, in the warning colour, "Still ended (<how long ago>). Add more days to reach today."
must_not: "Valid till then" for a day in the past

steps.action: Type 15
user_sees: "Valid till then (<in 5 days>)."
must_not: The member still shown as ended after the save

steps.action: Pick "Gift – Extra days" and tap "Add 15 days"
user_sees: "Plan moved 15 days later."; history "+15 days (Gift - extra days): …"
must_not: The reason saved as a freeze

start: Member page of a member with a personal-training pack that has 3 sessions left and ends this week

steps.action: Tap "Freeze / extra days" on the PT pack
user_sees: "<Pack name> last day: <date>. 3 PT sessions left."
must_not: The button on a pack with no sessions left
"1 PT sessions left."

steps.action: Pick "Freeze – Other", type "Wedding in the family" in "What happened (optional)", type 20 days
user_sees: "New last day" 20 days on; button "Add 20 days"
must_not: The gym plan's last day moving with the pack's

steps.action: Tap "Add 20 days"
user_sees: "Plan moved 20 days later."; history "+20 days (Freeze - Wedding in the family): …"
must_not: The sessions left changing

steps.action: Type 0 in "Or type the days (1–365)"
user_sees: Under the box: "A whole number from 1 to 365."
"New last day: —"
Button reads "Add days" and is greyed out
must_not: A save with zero days

steps.action: Type 366, then 3.5, then clear the box
user_sees: The same message for 366 and 3.5; no message for an empty box; the button stays greyed out
must_not: Days rounded without a word
More than a year added in one go

steps.action: Look at an earlier plan when a later gym plan exists, and at a cancelled plan
user_sees: No "Freeze / extra days" button on either
must_not: Days added to a plan that sits under a queued renewal

steps.action: If such a save is still sent (an old screen left open)
user_sees: "This member has a later plan. Add the days to the plan that ends last." or "This plan is cancelled. Undo the cancel first, or add the days to their current plan."
must_not: The days added anyway

steps.action: Sign in as the front desk and open the same member
user_sees: No "Freeze / extra days" button; on the PT card a plain note instead
must_not: A desk login moving a last day for free

steps.action: Turn the internet off
user_sees: The "Freeze / extra days" button cannot be pressed
must_not: Days that look added and are lost

start: Member page; the owner added 7 days a minute ago by mistake

steps.action: Open "Freeze / extra days" again
user_sees: The last day already 7 days later
must_not: The old last day

steps.action: Add 1 day
user_sees: From the code: the button reads "Add 1 days" and the message "Plan moved 1 days later."
must_not: Wrong grammar on the button and the message for one day

steps.action: Look for a way to take the 7 days back
user_sees: None in this sheet: it only adds days. Both history lines stay
must_not: The owner believing a wrong freeze can be undone here

steps.action: Sell a renewal after this plan, then look at the first plan
user_sees: "Freeze / extra days" is now on the renewal (the plan that ends last), not on the first plan
must_not: Days added to the earlier plan, overlapping the renewal

steps.action: Pick "Freeze – Medical" (or "Freeze – Other" and type what happened) and add the days
user_sees: History line "+7 days (Freeze - medical): …" on the member page
must_not: The reason shown to the member in the app without the gym choosing that (not checked)

steps.action: Sign in as the front desk and open the member page
user_sees: Unknown from the code read whether the desk sees the plan history with the reason; the history is part of the plan row
must_not: A typed health or family detail visible to people the owner did not expect; no word on the sheet says who will see it

steps.action: Download the gym's Excel backup
